questions.markdown: Design a circuit using a single op-amp to get the output voltage expression: $V_O = 3V_1 + 4V_2 - 1.5V_3 - 2.5V_4$, where $V_1$, $V_2$, $V_3$, and $V_4$ are input voltage sources. Provide the circuit diagram with suitable resistor values.
Draw the internal block diagram of op-amp and explain its different stages.

i) Draw the circuit used to measure the output resistance of an op-amp and derive the formula for calculating it.

ii) If the output voltage of op-amp is 10 V without a load and drops to 9.52 V when a 1 k$\Omega$ load is connected, calculate the output resistance of the op-amp.

Design a 4th order low-pass Butterworth filter with a passband gain of 30 dB and cutoff frequency of 2 kHz. Use $C = 0.01\,\mu$F. Determine the roll-off rate in the stopband by computing the gains in decibels at 5 kHz and 50 kHz.

For the given circuit, sketch the equivalent circuits corresponding to the positive and negative half-cycles of the input signal. Perform an analysis for each case and draw the resulting output waveform if the input is $5\sin(314t)$.
